newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BT cuts Maseca.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BT cuts Maseca.

text.p: -- Bankers Trust Securities analyst Kathleen Heaney on Thursday cut her rating for Grupo Industrial Maseca SA de CV to underperform from buy.

-- "Under the current conditions, we see little chance of the shares setting new highs for the remainder of the year, barring any announcement about the fate of the tortilla subsidy," Heaney wrote in a report.

-- "The current price, in our opinion, reflects a fair value of Maseca given the constraints facing the company for the current year. We are cautiously optimistic that this issue will be resolved before year-end.
-- "Over the longer term (we) believe the inevitable elimination of corn and tortilla subsidies will allow Maseca to achieve higher corn prices and once again resume its strong earnings growth."
-- American Depositary Receipts in the company dropped 3/8 to 15-5/8.
